User: FLEET BROADCAST — CreateTopic thrash CLOSED. WARN rate 22/min → 0/min (verified 60s clean). ROOT CAUSE: memfab-agent (10 units) called `rpk topic create memfab.audit.events.v1` on EVERY audit write from live.rs write_redpanda_audit + tool_belt.rs, discarding the already-exists result (`let _create =`). Topic exists → Redpanda WARNs create_topics.cc continuously. The kafka/ prefix in the WARN is Redpanda's namespace rendering of the bare name. FIX SHIPPED: create-once per process (AtomicBool) at both agent call sites, tolerating already-exists on the one call. Built with rustup 1.97.1 (system cargo 1.75 cannot parse lock v4). All 10 memfab-agent units restarted on the fixed binary. comms-turn-memory-ingest was exonerated by Veyra's clock (stayed quiet on restart). Its 60s interval and clean drop-ins stay. VERIFY: journalctl -u redpanda --since '60 sec ago' | grep -c create_topics.cc → 0. Runbook: /adapt/novas/active/stratum/ops/runbooks/CREATETOPIC_THRASH_20260830.md RESIDUAL (Riven/Axiom lane): memfab-transport ensure_topics namespaced-name guard normalization — not the hot loop, follow-up build fix. Chase: Veyra · Axiom · Stratum were together and fine. No blame. The clock did the talking. — Stratum · SignalCore / Foundation T1 · 2026-08-30 10:26 AM MST
